```{ojs}
// Student t PDF function
function tPDF(x, nu) {
  const B = Math.sqrt(nu * Math.PI) * gamma(nu/2) / gamma((nu+1)/2);
  return Math.pow(1 + x*x/nu, -(nu+1)/2) / B;
}

// Gamma function (simplified approximation)
function gamma(z) {
  const g = 7;
  const p = [0.99999999999980993, 676.5203681218851, -1259.1392167224028,
             771.32342877765313, -176.61502916214059, 12.507343278686905,
             -0.13857109526572012, 9.9843695780195716e-6, 1.5056327351493116e-7];
  
  if (z < 0.5) return Math.PI / (Math.sin(Math.PI * z) * gamma(1 - z));
  
  z -= 1;
  let x = p[0];
  for (let i = 1; i < g + 2; i++) x += p[i] / (z + i);
  
  const t = z + g + 0.5;
  return Math.sqrt(2 * Math.PI) * Math.pow(t, z + 0.5) * Math.exp(-t) * x;
}

// Student t CDF using numerical integration (Simpson's rule)
function tCDF(t, nu) {
  if (t === 0) return 0.5;
  
  const n = 1000; // number of intervals
  const a = t < 0 ? t : 0;
  const b = t < 0 ? 0 : t;
  const h = (b - a) / n;
  
  let sum = tPDF(a, nu) + tPDF(b, nu);
  
  for (let i = 1; i < n; i++) {
    const x = a + i * h;
    sum += (i % 2 === 0 ? 2 : 4) * tPDF(x, nu);
  }
  
  const integral = (h / 3) * sum;
  
  // For negative t, subtract from 0.5; for positive t, add to 0.5
  return t < 0 ? Math.max(0, integral) : 0.5 + integral;
}

// Helper function for linspace
function linspace(start, end, n = 100) {
  const step = (end - start) / (n - 1);
  return Array.from({length: n}, (_, i) => start + i * step);
}
```

```{ojs}
// Sliders
viewof t_nu = Inputs.range([1, 40], { value: 5, step: 1})
viewof t_value = Inputs.range([-5, 5], { value: 1.5, step: 0.001 })

```

```{ojs}
// Plot cell: reads t_nu, t_value; returns plot + math; NO sliders embedded here
{
  const ν = Math.round(t_nu);
  const t = t_value;

  const xPoints = linspace(-5, 5, 300);
  const pdfData = xPoints.map(x => ({ x, y: tPDF(x, ν) }));
  const fillData = xPoints.filter(x => x <= t).map(x => ({ x, y: tPDF(x, ν) }));
  const yAtT = tPDF(t, ν);
  const cdfValue = tCDF(t, ν);

  const rightMath = md`**CDF:** ${tex`\mathrm{Pr}(T \leq ${t.toFixed(3)}) = ${cdfValue.toFixed(6)}`}`;

  const plot = Plot.plot({
    width: Math.min(960, width),
    height: 320,
    marginBottom: 50,
    style: { background: "var(--plot-bg)", color: "var(--plot-fg)", fontFamily: bodyFont, fontSize: 14 },
    y: { label: "PDF", domain: [0, Math.max(...pdfData.map(d => d.y)) * 1.1] },
    x: { label: "x", domain: [-6, 6] },
    marks: [
      Plot.ruleY([0], { stroke: "var(--plot-grid)", strokeOpacity: 0.6 }),
      Plot.areaY(fillData, { x: "x", y: "y", fill: "var(--plot-series-1)", fillOpacity: 0.4 }),
      Plot.lineY(pdfData, { x: "x", y: "y", stroke: "var(--plot-series-1)", strokeWidth: 2 }),
      Plot.ruleX([{ x: t, y1: 0, y2: yAtT }], { x: "x", y1: "y1", y2: "y2", stroke: "var(--plot-fg)", strokeWidth: 2, strokeDasharray: "5,3" }),
      Plot.dot([{ x: t, y: yAtT }], { x: "x", y: "y", r: 4, fill: "var(--plot-fg)" }),
      Plot.text([{ x: t, y: 0 }], { x: "x", y: "y", text: d => `CDF = ${cdfValue.toFixed(3)}`, dy: -10, dx: t > 3 ? -40 : 40, fontSize: 12, fill: "var(--plot-fg)" })
    ]
  });

  return html`<div class="dist-panel">
    <div class="top-math-row"><div class="math">${rightMath}</div></div>
    <div class="plot-wrapper">${plot}</div>
  </div>`;
}
```

```{ojs}
// Styling
html`<style>
.dist-panel {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 960px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  text-align: center;
}

/* Center the math text */
.top-math-row .math {
  display: inline-block;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
  text-align: center;
  background: var(--header-bg);
  padding: 8px 12px;
  border-radius: 6px;
}

/* Center plot */
.plot-wrapper {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

/* Two columns that are allowed to shrink */
.controls-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr);
  gap: 12px 16px;
  max-width: 800px;
  margin: 0 auto;
}

/* Inline label + slider; allow shrinking */
.control-inline {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: row;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  min-width: 0;            /* critical: let this flex item shrink */
}

/* Keep math label tidy */
.control-inline .label {
  white-space: nowrap;
  min-width: 2ch;
}

/* The viewof wrapper is a <form>; let it flex and shrink */
.control-inline form {
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  min-width: 0;            /* critical: allow the form to shrink */
}

/* Make the actual slider fill the row */
.control-inline input[type="range"] {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 100%;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

/* Stack on small screens */
@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .controls-row {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
}

</style>`
```
